name: Dino Dearest
source:
Dino Dearest is a game about winning the hearts of a variety of dinosaurs and prehistoric dinosaur-like animals.

[From [url=https://dangstudios.itch.io/dinodearest] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Dino Dearest》是一款贏得各種恐龍與外型像恐龍的史前動物芳心的遊戲。

（來源：[url=https://dangstudios.itch.io/dinodearest]itch.io[/url]）
